title: Trajectory metadata reports the first accumulated usage instead of the final totals
reasoning: The parser iterates forward and records metrics only until accumulated_cost exists in metadata. Consequently, a trajectory containing successive cumulative metrics reports its earliest cost and token counts. The agent explicitly reads the last metrics entry, so parsing the saved artifact produces totals inconsistent with the execution accounting.
reproduction: Parse a trajectory containing two entries with increasing accumulated_cost and accumulated_token_usage. Metadata retains the first entry's values.
recommendation: Extract metadata from the last applicable metrics entry, consistently with the agent's usage extraction.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests were included; coverage for trajectories containing multiple cumulative metrics entries cannot be verified.
suggestedRegressionTest: Cover trajectories with increasing cumulative metrics and intervening entries without metrics; assert that parsed totals match the final metrics.
